purpose: bounded pipeline and transfer pilot; no default promotion or final accuracy claim
sampling: first eligible records in official file order per class/day; no prevalence claim
protected_names: exclude ECH/ESNI indications, including possible GREASE
group_rule: hash nonempty original connection IDs and destination identifier; reject cross-split connection reuse
progression: pilot data integrity and inference checks first; poor class support and this small biased sample preclude promotion; retain existing default and final test
